policy.scope: Complete Linux routing product including cloud/SAM and operational contracts; homert is one acceptance profile.
policy.calendar_estimates: Re-estimate from the first vertical slice and engine selection evidence; no unmeasured delivery date is asserted.

decisions.title: OS固有契約と任意executable
decisions.proposal: Packageの任意apt/dnf/pkg、journald sink、任意Plugin/provider executable、OS shell依存機能は、署名付きcapabilityとrouterdの管理面へ明示的に置換する案。未対応を拒否するだけでは旧契約全体のparityにならない。各inputごとに移行policy・理由・代替・受入を記録する。

decisions.title: 単一配布イメージと展開済み多binary runtime
decisions.proposal: 配布イメージは対象architecture/profileごとに一つとし、filesystemへ展開した複数binary/library/plugin/dataの束をruntime environmentにする。native moduleも独立binaryへ分割でき、二つのELFに固定しない。manifest digestでruntime全体を選択・固定・復旧し、個別componentの互換未確認な混在を許さない。

decisions.title: kernel書換権限
decisions.proposal: network writerへのbrokerを優先する。engineが直接XFRM等を管理する必要がある場合は、object namespace/owner/reconcile/foreign-state保護を限定した委譲ADRを先に合格させる。一般route/firewallの二重writerを黙認しない。

decisions.title: 旧動作互換とnativeの改善
decisions.proposal: BFD bootstrap/reset、health鮮度、IPv6 known-good rule、sticky、DNS finite ownership等は、legacy互換modeと明示replacementを分ける。現在のnative defaultsへ直接写して同等と数えない。

decisions.title: HAと移行方式
decisions.proposal: RouterdClusterはfile/flock/TTLの旧契約を基準にする。新旧node混在によるrolling migrationか、検証済みsnapshotを伴うmaintenance切替かを決め、選択した方式を二台で受入する。

decisions.title: 基準機能と追加配備先
decisions.proposal: baselineのIPv4 /32 SAMとAWS/Azure/Oracle Cloud executorをまず復元する。GCPの具体的adapter、Golden Images、K8s運用は個別にqualificationする。EVPN、独自CNI、FreeBSD portは今回のbaseline完了条件に追加しない。

decisions.title: engine版・license・配布資料
decisions.proposal: OS package名だけでなく正確なsource/build flags/dependencies/enabled componentsを固定する。nDPIの現在のcomponent別条件を確認し、process分離をlicense上の結論として扱わない。

decisions.title: boot config → runtime → startup-config
decisions.proposal: イメージの検証・展開、次回runtime選択、起動を分ける。小さなboot層はruntimeとstartup-configの参照を選び、選択runtimeが設定schemaを検証・適用する。設定journalとYAMLを独立した正本にせず、boot attemptの可変状態も設定意図と分離する。最初の実装方式はverified runtimeへのexecによるPID 1引継ぎを推奨する。

decisions.title: 未リリース routerd2 の形式互換は不要
decisions.proposal: routerdは稼働中の機能参照元、routerd2は未リリースの別製品。routerd2の二binary形式、manifest、boot schema、設定書式、journal、内部APIは破壊的に置換でき、互換reader・v1 bridge・prototype state移行は作らない。routerdから引き継ぐ機能の範囲は減らさず、routerd2の製品版間更新/復旧保証は初回リリースの新形式を基準に始める。

milestones.title: 実装チェックポイント
milestones.result: routerd2 8dfbf615、local/remote一致・clean。既存実装CI全成功。今回の計画作成前に確認。

milestones.title: resource 実行基盤と早期risk gate
milestones.exit: source program→依存評価→既存worker→状態→reconcileが一本通る。journal rollbackとengine/profile ADRの選択基準を持つ。

milestones.title: 単一ノードの WAN/LAN・経路切替
milestones.exit: Health→PBR/FIB→実packet、DS-Lite+第二経路/PPPoE、MSS、PD/LAN/DNS、基本resource APIを受入する。

milestones.title: 二台 HA と routing resource
milestones.exit: VRRP readiness、DHCP/PD継続、既存TCP/UDP NAT session維持、BGP/BFD/WG resource契約を別々に合格させて統合する。

milestones.title: SAM・federation・cloud mobility
milestones.exit: RR/leaf複数nodeとproviderごとの実captureで、所有権移動、/32、NATなし通信、revoke/drain/復旧を確認する。

milestones.title: 全運用surface と追加engine
milestones.exit: 旧API/CLI/Web/観測、選定engineの必要機能、権限分離をprofile別に受入する。

milestones.title: 更新・OSイメージ・配備先
milestones.exit: SSHからの安全な更新、state付きfallback、kernel/rootfs A/B、物理機/arm64/cloud/K8sを個別にqualificationする。

milestones.title: 互換性台帳と製品受入の確定
milestones.exit: 未対応・明示変更を隠さず、承認した契約集合の全ケースと性能・移行・戻し手順を証跡付きで閉じる。

判定を equivalent／explicit_replacement／unsupported／not_yet_implemented に分け、意味変更のdecision IDと試験証跡を持つ。

work_packages.title: ResourceProgram と単一の設定 transaction
deliverables: 元resource、identity、owner、provenanceを保持するResourceProgramと実行planを導入する。未公開のnative schema v1やDocument表現に互換制約を置かず、新しい入力・保存形式へ置換する。

新しいjournalのtransaction、失敗時復旧、confirmed commitのrollbackにsource graphとworker構成を含める。secret解決をpure validationから分離する。prototype永続recordの読取互換は不要。
boot entryが選ぶstartup-config store/revisionとrunning/candidateを区別する。startupの選択・保存を一つのauthoritative journalのtransactionとして定義し、初回seedは空storeだけに取り込む新仕様とする。
acceptance_gates: 新ResourceProgram/schema/journalで設定の適用・永続化・再起動を確認する。機能を検証する既存fixtureは新形式へ更新し、未公開native v1のbyte互換を要求しない。

work_packages.title: 依存・条件・resource lifecycle の coordinator
deliverables: when／dependsOn／ready_when／status reference、for/maxAge、true/false/indeterminate、循環検出を実装する。
resourceごとのstart/update/stop/delete、owner GC、対象を絞ったreconcile、再起動時の再評価を扱う。
既存runtimeplanへ型付きintentを渡す。未解決resourceを静的Documentへ無理に変換せず、待機理由を状態に残す。
acceptance_gates: 不明なVRRP roleでBACKUPがDHCP/PD sessionを開始しない。条件除外後の参照整理も旧契約と一致する。
dependency loss／source cutover／再起動／遅延した旧通知でforeign stateを消さず、新しい所有者を取り消さない。

implementation_notes.implemented: One coordinator owns kernel application, worker reconciliation and application ACKs against actual supervisor registration. Each accepted source prepares immutable protocol worker configs, canonical child-file bytes and digests once outside the observation mutex, including conditionally inactive and generated RA workers. Ordinary projections select these definitions; BGP/VRRP typed configs and static LAN RA templates are reused. Cutover selects matching live observations without rebuilding identities. Dynamic RA prefix/lifetime/DNS data stays outside immutable worker config. Finite readiness and original protocol deadlines still bound kernel resources and consumers. No extra manager, invalidation flag, synthetic producer, receipt lease or prototype adapter was added. Worker ABI 3 and stored formats are unchanged; the current compiler contract is native-13 after adding DHCPv4 relay. Protocol network projection now owns only the collections it changes and shares fixed intent read-only, removing its JSON round-trip copy.
implementation_notes.validation: Worker-file bytes match supervisor digests. The worker-preparation change in 61a2918 passed the six BFD/BGP cases and reduced static projection plus selection for eight BGP routers/64 peers each from median 2.531 ms/540004 bytes/1238 allocations to 7.756 us/4021 bytes/20 allocations; this is not packet throughput or learned-RIB performance. The current projection-ownership build passed local source/earlier-projection immutability during RA withdrawal and address/route expiry, full make check (Race Detector and vet), and static amd64/arm64 builds. Actual two-WAN Health/PBR, PD/RA renewal/renumber/expiry/reacquisition with routed TCP/UDP, AFTR, IPv6 VRF BFD/BGP and Keepalived Health tracking passed with the current binaries. The six-ELF signed bundle/catalog/publisher checks passed. Output paths are in docs/pve-codex-handoff.md. arm64 was not executed.
remaining: The historical BFD reconnection timeout still lacks direct failed-request diagnostics. IPv6 multicast now has independent Keepalived VIP TCP/UDP and wire checks, but the earlier bridged missing-advertisement cause remains unresolved. The initial IPv6 unicast TCP timeout with election-authority expiry was reproduced once on current products; syscall tracing did not reproduce it. Request-time snapshots were added to failure diagnostics; neither client deadlines nor election authority were extended.

Keep other accepted protocol data typed, compile static condition work and remove the remaining writer snapshot JSON round-trip copying. DHCP client allocation and durable retention still depend on UTC; these changes do not qualify allocation across wall-clock correction, power loss or physical suspend.

Expiry while the network writer itself is unavailable and physical suspend remain unqualified. Recursive prerequisite address/link deadline propagation has local projection checks; equivalent paused-control real-daemon cases are not yet exercised.

deliverables: EventRule／DerivedEvent、durable journal、consumer cursor、outbox、再送・dedup・期限を移植する。
durable event、freshnessを持つprotocol fact、欠落を許容するlogを別のchannelと保持契約にする。

work_packages.title: link・address・WAN resource の完全化
deliverables: link/Bridge/VRF/VXLANの残りのoption/lifecycleとSelfAddressPolicyのcandidate/suffix/ordinal/fallbackをtyped selectionへ移す。

worker停止・control停止・kernel rebootを区別し、古いsourceで所有資源が復活しない。
独立DHCPv6 serverとのIA_NA取得/renew/rebind/expiry/restartを確認する。同一interfaceのPD/informationとUDP 546 socket・DUID/IAIDの所有権を共有でき、RA trigger/MTU/hop-limitとresolver効果も対応方針どおりに動く。

implementation_notes.implemented: Owned dummy links use the existing native link writer, ownership journal and lifetime handling. Declared routing-domain resolution follows master chains and includes the VRF device itself; config BFD source checks and recursive BGP FIB address resolution share it. A native DHCPv6 client now owns IA_NA, IA_PD and information on one interface/socket/DUID/IAID; explicit request_address/request_prefix can share one stateful transaction. Multiple assignments have individual preferred/valid deadlines. The network writer projects IA_NA as /128 and derives LAN addresses/RA from prefixes. The pinned PD state-machine wrapper, corrections, embedded snapshot and discarded lease-journal reader are removed. Only DUID identity is persisted, and restart acquires fresh server authority. Pure contracts live in dhcp6config; the protocol engine stays out of boot/config. The signed compiler contract is native-13.
implementation_notes.validation: The actual daemon configures owned dummy source links under VRFs and root loopback sources. IPv4 and IPv6 routed BFD/BGP and user TCP/UDP operate simultaneously in three domains with identical endpoint addresses. IPv6 uses explicitly coordinated usable link-local addresses with NoDAD on every forwarding link; initial automatic tentative link-local addresses prevented ND and the first TCP SYN. This observed setup dependence is documented, not hidden by longer deadlines. An independent DHCPv6 server builds wire replies without the product codec. The real daemon obtains/renews/renumbers PD, advertises current/deprecated LAN prefixes from the same RA worker, forwards actual client TCP/UDP, retires RA and owned addresses at expiry, and reacquires with the same immutable identity. make check-pd-ra reproduces this gate. Independent dnsmasq with real daemon workers passed IA_NA acquisition, DNS/search, source-bound TCP/UDP after kernel DAD, SIGKILL/replacement with stable DUID/IAID and config digest, actual Renew/Reply, server silence through Renew/Rebind, kernel address expiry/removal and fresh acquisition on the same worker. make check-dhcp6 reproduces this gate. An independent wire server passed combined IA_NA/IA_PD transactions with the same IAID, current/deprecated LAN RA, routed client TCP/UDP, RA retirement and owned address removal, and reacquisition.
remaining: Required/observe-only resource readiness, complete DHCPv6Address legacy resource selection, RA-triggered DHCPv6, RA MTU/hop-limit and resolver effects; DAD-failure/Decline, graceful Release, VRF, actual UTC correction/suspend and reboot qualification.
Complete link option/lifecycle and ownership/adoption semantics and WAN selection. Automatic IPv6 link-local DAD startup, arbitrary forwarded VRF policy and target NICs remain unqualified.

work_packages.title: LAN・DHCPv6・relay・DNS の resource 完全化
deliverables: DHCPv6 serverのstateful/stateless/both/RA-only、Rapid Commit、動的pool/optionsとDHCPv4 relayを実装する。
v4 scope/profile/reservation/options、旧global sticky、fingerprint、lease importをowned journalへ接続する。

active chainとstandalone rendererの差、global sticky hold/replay、予約競合と複数serverをfixture化する。
DNS TCP接続とlistenerを維持しつつ、静的record優先・source消失・revocation・再取得を検証する。

implementation_notes.implemented: Generated LAN RA uses a source-prepared immutable worker template and separate live prefix/lifetime/DNS input. Native DHCPv4/RA primitives already exist; this does not implement the complete LAN resource scope. Native DHCPv4 relay owns one listener per routing domain with per-client-interface upstreams and committed giaddr dependencies; it owns no leases, retry queues or protocol journal. Static legacy DHCPv4Relay declarations compile to this worker. DHCP server and relay share the pure Ethernet IPv4/UDP encoder, and immutable worker serialization no longer uses an untyped application config variable. Removed MTU-exceeding relay reply drops. The shared Ethernet IPv4/UDP encoder fragments against each output interface MTU, retains a single datagram ID and UDP checksum, and recomputes each IP header checksum/offset. Relay and native server socket owners seed their output identification once and increment it per datagram; no fragment journal, cache or compatibility path was added. Incoming relay replies now retain their actual kernel routing-domain context: resolve the received interface through its current bridge/VRF master chain and require the configured domain in addition to server and giaddr. The same kernel-domain walk validates client interface ownership. No transaction cache, synthetic producer or sysctl override was added.
implementation_notes.validation: The current relay-vrf binaries passed actual independent dnsmasq/BusyBox peers in blue/red/default domains sharing server IP and giaddr, with distinct DHCP domain options and TCP/UDP responders. With udp_l3mdev_accept=1 in the disposable namespace, a genuine queued blue server reply leaked onto the default LAN on 3c28a9e after blue relay retirement. The fix preserved that reply arriving on blue WAN while no client LAN received it; red/default workers kept PID/generation, and restoring blue recovered a new generation of the same instance intent. The existing two-LAN DORA, MTU-600 large unicast/broadcast reassembly, original giaddr/hops, hop-limit, TCP/UDP and worker-restart fixture also passed after sharing the actual peer launch/acquisition helpers. Current make check (full Race Detector and vet), six static amd64/arm64 builds, the final two relay fixtures and six-ELF signed bundle/catalog/publisher checks passed. Output paths are in docs/pve-codex-handoff.md. arm64 was not executed.
remaining: DHCPv6 server modes, relay HA and dynamic-domain qualification, full dynamic pool/options and DNS addressFrom/resource priority, global sticky/fingerprint/lease import and lease-sync contracts remain incomplete. Host SLAAC/DNS behavior, full server interoperability and clock/suspend qualification are not established by the PD/RA fixture.

work_packages.title: BGP/BFD resource と大規模経路の契約
deliverables: BGPRouter/BGPPeer/BGPDynamicPeerのpolicy/source/VRF/redistribution/eligibilityとBFD参照・profileを接続する。
interface無しで元が生成するmultihop BFDを実装し、local address解決、legacy reset modeとnative strict modeを分ける。
全世代単位のRIB snapshot、分割転送/backpressure/上限超過の状態を定義し、現在の4096 selected pathsを無条件の互換上限にしない。
acceptance_gates: 独立BGP/BFD peerとのIPv4/v6、RR/dynamic peer、VRF/recursive/ECMP、single/multihopを確認する。
BFD never-upでのBGP起動、既知Up→Downのhard reset、再起動とstrict gatingを別fixtureで試験する。
大量更新/切替中の部分RIBを完全snapshotと解釈せず、withdraw/owner期限切れとSAM /32 deliveryを確認する。

implementation_notes.implemented: Explicit single-hop and multihop BFD support declared VRFs. Multihop UDP 4784 receivers use SO_REUSEADDR so an unbound default-domain endpoint can coexist with VRF-bound endpoints at the same address. Existing per-domain/address abstract claims reject a second routerd receiver; TX ports remain exclusive and SO_REUSEPORT is not enabled. Source ownership, original packet/source deadlines, matching BGP transport scope and VRF FIB tables remain explicit. BGP normalization no longer JSON-encodes/decodes the entire config: the pinned normalizer rebuilds slices/maps, and native maps and graceful-restart pointers are copied directly. Worker ABI 3 and stored formats are unchanged; the current compiler contract is native-13 after adding DHCPv4 relay.
implementation_notes.validation: Actual routed IPv4 and IPv6 BFD/BGP with identical endpoints operates simultaneously in two VRFs and the default domain. Distinct user TCP/UDP responses identify the three paths. Blue-only UDP loss/recovery and BFD replacement preserve unrelated sessions and workers. Freezing default BFD expires a retained raw UP snapshot, closes BGP and withdraws only its learned route; fresh receive evidence restores the same workers. Capture checks UDP 4784 and outgoing 255/incoming 254 on all three egresses. A real native socket test rejects duplicate multihop ownership for both families. The IPv6 topology explicitly coordinates link-local ND sources with NoDAD. A 512-peer normalization benchmark on this VM changed median 3.606 ms/835122 bytes to 0.351 ms/199417 bytes; this is not packet-throughput qualification. Check outcomes and the unresolved TCP timeout are recorded in docs/pve-codex-handoff.md. Final make check (including full Race Detector and vet), all six real-daemon cases, the native socket gate, static amd64/arm64 builds and six-ELF signed bundle/catalog/publisher checks passed. arm64 was not executed.
remaining: Original BGPRouter/BGPPeer/BGPDynamicPeer source/profile/redistribution and typed resource lifecycle are incomplete. Current strict BFD startup gating is an explicit native replacement, not identical opportunistic pre-Up legacy reset behavior.

Multihop authentication, dynamic local-source selection, VRF/path selection changes, automatic link-local DAD startup, IPv6 single-hop VRF/link-local next-hop/ECMP acceptance, scale/backpressure/full-generation RIB transfer and physical/arm64 runtime qualification remain incomplete. Bound socket isolation does not qualify all forwarded VRF policy.

One IPv4 user TCP dial timed out at 300 ms after default BFD was paused; capture contains SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK at the end of that attempt. Later traced and untraced executions passed. The cause remains unproven, and client/protocol deadlines were not extended.

work_packages.implementation_notes: Native VRRP election and coordinator-owned graceful admission implemented. Admission consumes finite readiness when kernel application begins; successful ownership survives readiness loss, while failed application creates no admission. Original boot expiry and producer fences remain. Native IPv4/IPv6 unicast peers now use source/interface-bound raw IP sockets, explicit peer/local-destination checks, TTL/Hop Limit 255 and actual IPv6 checksum destinations. Empty peer lists are rejected rather than falling back to multicast. Independent keepalived interoperability covers actual daemon VIP TCP/UDP, takeover, worker SIGKILL/rebind, peer stop, lower-priority recovery and bidirectional packet capture. Receive processing uses actual IP metadata instead of fabricated Ethernet headers. Health tracking uses configured penalties, consecutive accepted probe counts and required original-sample max age. Replays and RPC polling cannot advance confirmation; authority gaps and producer replacement require fresh recovery samples. Finite tracking decisions share the existing applied-ownership response, with local boot-clock expiry and effective wire priority derived from base intent. No Health-flap configuration rewriting or VRRP restart. Independent keepalived tests confirm real-daemon Health failure/recovery, original-sample expiry during SIGSTOP and Health SIGKILL/rebind, native priorities 150/50 in capture, and VIP TCP/UDP on both owners. Explicit IPv4 VRRPv2 now implements whole-second intervals, fixed one-second skew, interval-match rejection, inferior-advertisement discard and optional RFC 2338 PASS with complete authentication words and no silent password truncation. Version is reported in the election snapshot. Independent Keepalived tests cover v2 multicast without authentication and unicast PASS, wrong-password rejection, real VIP TCP/UDP takeover and recovery, worker replacement and capture checks of version, interval, authentication data, destination and TTL. No version negotiation or automatic fallback. Conditional additional MAC/link-local identities use ordinary link/interface/address resources gated by elected/active facts. Their original condition and dependency deadlines are carried into the network writer; it fences links DOWN and removes managed addresses independently of control. Address lifetimes are intersected with link authority. Finite MACs announce L2 location with RARP while current, without extending authority. Compiler contract is resource-program-native-13 and worker ABI is 3; network ownership journal is format 5. Declared resource references now share original typed Health/BFD/BGP observations. Explicit false when conditions produce finite neutral decisions preserving counters and penalty; unknown or expired conditions cannot create neutral authority. Other resource kinds and their Disabled/NotApplicable/Standby phase contracts, external secret resolution, peer-aware legacy import, cluster, symmetric native DHCP/PD/NAT continuity, VRF unicast and hardware qualification remain incomplete. Independent Keepalived IPv6 multicast with explicit link-local sources now verifies ff02::12, hop limit 255, both-owner VIP TCP/UDP, priority takeover and worker replacement/recovery. Earlier bridged missing reception and intermittent initial IPv6 unicast timeout/authority expiry remain unresolved; passing runs do not close them. Removed the redundant post-notification advert-timer reset. Slow initial ownership ACKs now renew on the original election schedule; local and actual paused-writer before/after comparisons cover the failure. An earlier post-fix apply timeout under simultaneous checks remains unexplained; load and hardware qualification remain open.

cross compileだけでarm64 applianceを合格にせず、read-only rootfsと必要な書込領域が分離されている。
未検証artifactをactive/trial slotへ選ばず、欠けたkernel feature/module/ABIと改竄を準備段階で拒否する。
新形式のknown-good runtimeと更新候補を使い、初回リリース以降に支えるbootstrap/runtime組合せとfallbackを実bootで検証する。非対応ABIを選択前に拒否し、boot層更新失敗でも正常な入口を保持する。

criteria: kernel/modules/rootfs/profile/state互換性とimage assemblyを対象boot方式で定義する。
artifactとboot selector metadataを署名検証してからstage/slotを選択する。
共通のpersistent state/初回identityと対象providerのboot/update契約を受入する。
新形式のbootstrap/runtime ABIとruntime/config参照のhandoffを受入し、初回リリース以降の対応版間更新・fallbackを定義する。未公開形式の移行は含めない。
対象のUEFI/U-Boot等のboot方式、driver/firmware、電源断、watchdog、persistent stateを物理機別に受入する。

work_packages.title: 各クラウドの OS image と provisioning
deliverables: AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle Cloud別のimage build/import recipe、metadata、初回identity/key、multi-NIC/IPv6/MTUと永続stateを実装する。
Alpine等のbase imageをbuildに使い、最終boot lifecycleと必要なprovider機能を明示する。
OCI container formatとOracle Cloudのmachine imageを別artifactとして扱う。
cloud imageへboot層とfilesystemに展開したruntimeを用意し、装置固有startup-config/identityをruntime root外で初期化する。provider別にboot configと実runtime/configの選択を検証する。
acceptance_gates: providerごとの使い捨てVMで起動、routing、reboot、host key/state持続、修復とcleanupを確認する。
共有したhost key/secretをGolden Imageへ焼き込まず、metadata異常・複数NIC・再登録を検証する。
buildやAPI mockの成功だけでlive cloud-qualifiedにしない。
実VMの最終bootでrouterdがPID 1、管理は内蔵SSH、engineは署名profileから起動する。init/cloud-init/service managerに残したruntime依存がないことを確認する。

work_packages.title: Kubernetes router workload と管理連携
deliverables: Pod/host network namespaceを明示し、既存CNIとの共存、capabilities/sysctl、永続state、readiness/drainを持つ配布manifestを作る。
必要なcontroller/operatorをtyped revision/ownership APIに接続する。イメージ更新はorchestratorに任せる。
独自CNI pluginは追加製品として切り分け、ルータPodを動かすための必須作業へ追加しない。
同じmanifestのruntime集合をOCI image内に展開して配る。Pod内にappliance用installer/boot selectorを必須として重ねず、image選択はorchestrator、startup-config/stateは明示volumeとする。
acceptance_gates: reschedule/node failureで旧ownerが広告や権限を維持せず、経路撤去と管理到達性を確認する。
Pod netns profileはhost networkを変更しない。hostNetwork profileは明示委譲されたobjectのみ管理し、既存CNIの資源を採用/削除しない。両profileともhost clock/watchdog/rebootを操作しない。
controller Readyだけでなく実traffic、永続identity、update/rollbackと切替中の状態を検証する。

work_packages.title: 全体互換・移行・性能の製品受入
deliverables: 全resource/surfaceのcaseをequivalent／承認済みreplacement／unsupported／未完了へ確定し、未完了を残してfull parityを名乗らない。
homert単体/二台、RR/leafとcloud SAM、optional engine、appliance/cloud/K8sを別profileで受入する。
同条件の旧routerd比較、packet loss/convergence、throughput/pps/latency、CPU、RSS/PSS、起動時間、route/peer/conntrack容量を測る。
acceptance_gates: field/default/lifecycle/status/event、実protocol、実daemon/recovery、migration/rollbackの全証跡が揃う。
既存の機能・通信・障害回復テストを新構成へ更新し、新gateはrequired testとPASS markerを要求する。環境不足をskip成功にせず、旧prototype形式の維持も要求しない。
旧/新node混在や本番切替は、選んだ方式の独立受入と戻し手順がある。実機/クラウド未検証profileをqualifiedと表示しない。
runtime binary数に依存せず、manifestが宣言したsupervisor/required workersとstartup-configの組合せを受入する。未公開二ELF形式との互換試験は不要で、既存の機能試験は新構成へ適応する。

first_changes.deliverable: field/default/status/event fixturesと旧実行環境のmanifest。新native機能を作る前に互換判定を再現する。
ResourceProgramと新schema/journal transaction、confirmed rollback、startup-config選択を実装する。未公開native v1 adapterや旧record読取互換は作らず、既存fixtureを新形式に更新する。
三値条件・依存・ownerの最小coordinator。既存Interface/address/routeでstart/update/remove/recoveryを通す。 CORE-04のprotocol fact/freshnessと再起動時失効の最小契約を並行して定義し、次のHealth workerへ渡す。
Health workerとscoped Netlink route lookup。二つの独立pathのprobeを実packetで識別する。

required_inputs.item: サニタイズしたhomert02/03の最新設定、使用中の外部engine版、期待するWAN/PBR/HA動作。未入手でもsource fixtureとisolated labの実装は進める。
各engineの正確な版・plugin・配布条件。用途に必要な機能集合をPoCの合否にする。
新旧node混在を必要とするか、maintenance切替を許すか。選んだ方式のfixtureと戻し手順を用意する。

acceptance_profiles.criterion: 全public resourceと非resource surfaceの契約をcaseごとに閉じる。equivalentとexplicit replacementを別集計し、後者をstrict semantic parityへ算入しない。
DS-Lite/PPPoE、二経路probe/PBR、MTU/MSS、PD/RA、DHCP/DNSが実daemonと独立peerで動き、障害後に復旧する。
二台切替でVIP readiness、WAN/LAN identity、DHCP/PDと既存TCP/UDP NAT sessionを継続する。選択したmigration方式も受入する。
独立した2 RR＋4 leafのlabを初期目標とし、/32、NATなし双方向通信、所有権移動、capture/revoke/drain、障害復旧を検証する。node数は容量上限ではない。
選択した外部engineの全必要機能、artifact closure、実backend、state/upgradeとlicense資料をprofile単位で確認する。 native moduleも任意個数のbinaryへ分割でき、runtime全体のmanifestと依存解決を検証する。

対象amd64/arm64 hardware別にboot/update、電源断、persistent state、driver/firmwareを検証する。 SYS-03のruntime-authorityとappliance-watchdog、および対象のhardware-qualificationを要求する。 boot config→展開済みruntime→startup-config、初回リリース以降のbootstrap更新/復旧を含める。
AWS/Azure/GCP/Oracle Cloudごとに実VMのboot/reboot/routing/state/cleanupを受入する。provider操作のparityとは別判定。 DIST-02のimage-boot-contractを必要とし、別機種のhardware-qualificationは待たない。
既存CNIと共存したrouter workloadでtraffic、reschedule/drain、identity/state、namespaceと更新を受入する。独自CNIは含めない。 SYS-03のruntime-authorityを必要とし、appliance-watchdogは待たない。

runtime_delivery.distribution_unit: One signed distribution image per target architecture/profile.
runtime_delivery.runtime_environment: Multiple binaries and declared runtime dependencies extracted onto the filesystem into an immutable directory identified by the manifest digest.
runtime_delivery.binary_count: Not fixed; native modules and upstream engines may use independent or explicitly grouped multicall executables.
runtime_delivery.startup_config_authority: Selected authoritative config store/revision in the new schema, with explicit selection/save transactions and initial seed only for an empty store. Prototype serialized formats may be replaced.
runtime_delivery.recommended_handoff: Small bootstrap execs the verified runtime supervisor, which inherits PID 1; bootstrap does not remain a watchdog after exec.
runtime_delivery.mutable_state: Outside immutable runtime roots; boot intent, attempt state, configuration, identities, revocations, leases and cursors have separate contracts.
runtime_delivery.prototype_compatibility: None. Replace unreleased two-binary, boot, manifest and journal formats directly; no compatibility reader, shim bridge or prototype migration gate.
runtime_delivery.first_supported_format: The new extracted multi-binary runtime format.
runtime_delivery.startup_configuration_status: conditional fixed-runtime recovery and internal atomic runtime/configuration release journal implemented; coordinated signed loader, live writer/trial fences, compatibility and health integration pending
